desc: 亮面蜗牛机身背驮转盘电话的潮玩公仔，端盒抽隐藏款，桌面摆着就抢眼
leaf: 魔法电话虫（黄色蜗牛机身背驮蓝色转盘电话造型的 PVC/ABS 卡通手办盲盒摆件）
name: 糖果色魔法电话虫手办盲盒款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一秒看清这是一只亮面卡通手办而不是毛绒或积木，靠干净剪影抢点击并满足白底合规。
详情页首屏承接主图点击，用一行大字加一条胶囊副标把这款公仔的气质与品类一秒说完。
shots.textZone: display headline 「{selling_point_1}」 upper left in #EF4B57 with a thin #FFFFFF keyline, one pill subline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on a solid #EF4B57 capsule directly under it

shots.intent: 放大盲盒买家最怕的两件事，抽到重款和凑不齐一套，把规则解释的必要性先立起来。
shots.textZone: one short top-centre label 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D plus two small contrast chips 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 at the panel bottoms

shots.intent: 把源页散盒与整盒两套买法摆成同框对照，替买家一次算清该单抽还是端盒。
shots.textZone: one heading placeholder 「{callout_4}」 at the top of each panel in #2D2D2D, one short caption line 「{callout_5}」 under each panel

shots.intent: 给一个选款决策位，把系列里可得的公仔与保密款并列排齐，替买家看清池子有多大。
shots.textZone: heading 「{selling_point_3}」 across the top in #EF4B57, one short label 「{callout_6}」 inside each corner badge, one highlighted pill 「{callout_7}」 under the grid

shots.intent: 把公仔放进真实书桌，让买家代入自己桌面上那个位置，从摆件价值而不是参数去打动人。
shots.textZone: one short bottom band label 「{callout_8}」 at 14pt in #2D2D2D

shots.intent: 用微距让亮面漆、分色边界与模具细节自己说话，把做工证明交给画面而不是话术。
shots.textZone: one small numbered circle badge in the lower corner holding a single short label

shots.intent: 沿用源页三张编号细节卡的结构，把上色、材质与做工三件可看的事一次交完。
shots.textZone: heading 「{selling_point_4}」 across the top of the field, one number 01 02 03 plus one caption 「{callout_10}」 under each card

shots.intent: 用一张俯视全家福加一栏规格占位收掉风险，把尺寸、材质与件数交给卖家自填而不编造。
shots.textZone: heading 「{callout_11}」 inside the blue panel plus four short spec rows 「{callout_12}」 with a dashed keyline box reserved for seller values

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口，用一条理由加一个明确按钮把看完犹豫的买家推进加购。
shots.textZone: heading and one support line inside the dashed yellow panel, rounded CTA button below them

style.backgroundSystem: soft bubblegum-pink field #FBA7BE with pale pink #FFDCE7 light streaks and flat candy-dreamland sticker shapes (a small striped disc, a domed saucer silhouette) used only on the first screen; every infographic screen puts its product photo inside one rounded 24-32px corner card keyed with a thin #FFFFFF outline; info copy sits on solid #F9C45C or #A5D3EF lozenge cards; never a photographic stock interior behind an infographic
style.direction: candy-pop blind-box art-toy ecommerce, bubblegum-pink dreamland screens mixed with glossy vinyl packshots
style.iconSystem: flat candy sticker shapes only: one striped #F9C45C disc badge carrying a slim tilted #EF4B57 pill banner across it, solid #A5D3EF lozenge cards each holding one blue sphere badge with a single short placeholder glyph, and 01-03 numbered circles; no line-icon sets, no certificates, no seals, no QR codes
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key light at 5400K from the upper front with a soft bounce fill on the shadow side, controlled glossy highlights on painted vinyl, no blown speculars, and a true soft contact shadow under every figure; the single lifestyle screen uses 4500K window light from camera left with all shadows falling consistently to the right
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent candy-pop blind-box art-toy ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF card field, bubblegum-pink #FBA7BE with pale pink #FFDCE7 background field, coral-red #EF4B57 display ink, candy-yellow #F9C45C and sky-blue #A5D3EF info cards and #2D2D2D body text, alongside the product's own reference colors which never change; warm candy tone; one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family with chunky #EF4B57 display headlines at 34-48pt carrying a thin #FFFFFF keyline, 16-20pt sublines inside one solid coral pill and 10-14pt #2D2D2D body labels, all Chinese copy carried only as short 「{selling_point_N}」 and 「{callout_N}」 placeholders under 45 characters per screen; background system of a soft bubblegum-pink field with flat candy-dreamland sticker shapes on the opening screen and rounded 24-32px #FFFFFF product cards on every infographic screen, never a photographic stock interior; lighting system of bright even high-key light at 5400K from the upper front with a soft bounce fill, controlled glossy highlights on painted vinyl and a true contact shadow under every figure, the lifestyle screen only at 4500K window light from camera left; surface system of matte #FFFFFF card surfaces and one pale #F0EAE6 shelf board; icon system of flat candy sticker shapes only, a striped #F9C45C disc badge with a slim tilted #EF4B57 pill banner, solid #A5D3EF lozenge cards with one sphere badge holding a single short placeholder glyph and 01-03 numbered circles; product presentation of one stable 3/4 walking attitude and identical scale in every screen, colour blocking and finish taken only from the reference and never floating without a contact shadow; no color palette changes, no new accent colors, no mixed fonts, no brush or handwritten lettering, no random backgrounds, no photographic skies, no inconsistent lighting, no missing contact shadows, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes, no membership or store badges, no invented prices, odds, piece counts, age grades or certifications.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors beyond the fixed candy palette
no mixed fonts, no brush, handwritten, serif or pixel lettering
no random backgrounds and no photographic stock interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no figure without a contact shadow
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no QR codes, no membership stickers, no store badges, no watermark
no invented prices, draw odds, piece counts, age grades or safety certifications
style.presentationRules: the figure keeps one stable 3/4 walking attitude and identical scale across all screens, standing on its own contact shadow and never floating; colour blocking, glossy paint finish and moulded facial elements come only from the reference image and never re-mix between screens; at least one overhead and one low camera per set; no recognizable child face and no hands anywhere
style.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF card surface as the default product ground, one pale #F0EAE6 shelf board as the only furniture surface; pastel candy ground with a soft scalloped edge on the opening screen; surfaces stay clean, with no duplicated prop pattern
style.typography: one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; chunky display headline 34-48pt solid #EF4B57 with a thin #FFFFFF keyline, 16-20pt subline set inside one solid coral pill in #FFFFFF, 10-14pt body labels in #2D2D2D on yellow and blue cards; all rendered Chinese copy is a short 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」 placeholder, per-screen budget under 45 characters
